title: Skill Project 1 — [In Progress]: Student Grade Tracker
description: A console app (Java OOP + Collections). Add students, assign marks per subject, calculate averages, rank them, search by name. Forces you to use classes, ArrayLists, Maps, sorting, and basic file I/O to save data. No DB yet — just .txt or .json file persistence. Done when you can run it fresh, add 10 students, and the ranking is correct after a restart.
